Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a GFP-trap to identify the interactome of a catalytically inactive USP11 mutant. While the study focuses on ubiquitination, the MS analysis itself was a global protein identification of the co-precipitated complex using LFQ, not a remnant-motif enrichment (like diGly) or a PTM-specific enrichment (like TiO2). Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the primary modifier.
